discriminating_question: Does any prior method perform joint, non-pairwise compatibility over a complete candidate combination, AND learn to select and maintain among the results, AND do so against a reactive evader in a lane-constrained domain with vehicle bodies?

acceptance_rule.REFUTED: a primary record implements the conjunction
acceptance_rule.DOCUMENTED_TECHNICAL_DIFFERENCE: all five families resolved and read at method level, none implements the conjunction
acceptance_rule.POTENTIAL_DIFFERENCE: one or more families remain unresolved

prohibited: narrowing the discriminating question to make a source non-refuting
upgrading a reading depth not actually achieved
declaring a family closed because a search returned nothing
